responsibility: Defines the diagnostic state accumulated while lexing token trees for delimiter matching, and provides helper routines that analyze indentation, empty blocks, and unmatched delimiter information to produce more targeted brace and delimiter mismatch labels.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `parser/diagnostics.rs`, this file is limited to lexing-time delimiter diagnostics: it stores token-tree brace state and refines mismatched/unclosed delimiter messages from indentation and empty-block evidence before parsing begins.
